title: Clock divisions in a live-code grid (Orca)
description: ORCA executes three clock operators at rates 1, 2 and 4. Actual interpreter outputs are recorded for three cycle lengths and checked against their expected timing.

tool_about: ORCA executes three clock operators at rates 1, 2 and 4. Actual interpreter outputs are recorded for three cycle lengths and checked against their expected timing. Runs the original ORCA interpreter and clock operators in Node.js, with no MIDI, OSC or external-device output. Values are recorded after each interpreter frame.
tool_about_ko: ORCA 원본 인터프리터에서 속도 1·2·4의 클록 연산자를 실행했어요. 세 주기의 출력 시간을 기록하고 기대한 타이밍과 대조했어요. 보기는 저장된 결과를 선택하며 계산을 바꾸려면 레시피를 재실행하세요.
